name: Indiana
localTaxNote: Indiana counties levy their own income tax on top of the state rate. The county rate depends on the county of residence and is not included in this calculation.
notes: Every Indiana county adds its own income tax on top of the state rate; it depends on the county you live in on January 1.

dependentAllowance.source: Departmental Notice #1: $1,000 per exemption, dependents included, and a further $1,500 for each qualifying dependent child

against.title: Indiana Department of Revenue, Departmental Notice #1 (effective October 1, 2026): "For 2026, the state adjusted gross income tax rate for individuals is 2.95%"; $1,000 per personal exemption; $1,500 per additional dependent exemption

verified.correction: Adds the $1,000 personal exemption (two on a joint return), $1,000 for each dependent and the further $1,500 for each dependent child; none were in the extracted record.

countyIncomeTax.basis: The county rate applies to the same base as the state tax: wages less the exemptions. Marion County on a $95,000 salary, single: (95,000 - 1,000) x 2.02% = 1,898.80.
countyIncomeTax.source: Indiana Department of Revenue, Departmental Notice #1, county tax rates effective October 1, 2026; a resident pays the rate of the county they live in on January 1
